findings.title: Orders can't keep up
findings.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 3/s and handles 1/s (300%): its backlog only grows.

findings.title: Every request goes through one Orders
findings.message: It runs 1 replica at 300% of what it can handle, and every request from Checkout goes through it: if it stops or slows, Checkout gets nothing.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
